claims: The Los Angeles Dodgers opened their 2026 season on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at Dodger Stadium.
The Los Angeles Dodgers defeated the Arizona Diamondbacks 8-2 in their 2026 season opener.
Yoshinobu Yamamoto started the game for the Los Angeles Dodgers in their 2026 season opener.
The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener featured a pre-game banner-raising ceremony for their 2025 World Series win.
The Los Angeles Dodgers won the 2025 World Series.
Will Smith and Andy Pages homered in the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener, according to USA Today.
The Los Angeles Dodgers celebrated their 2025 World Series championship with a special ceremony before their 2026 season opener, notes KTLA YouTube channel.
The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener is part of a 6-game homestand to start the season.
Dodger Stadium gates opened at 2:30 p.m. PT for the first pitch of the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener, according to ABC7 Los Angeles.
The first pitch of the Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener was at 5:30 p.m. PT, according to ABC7 Los Angeles.
The Los Angeles Dodgers' 2026 season opener was available via local broadcast/streaming, according to USA Today.
